title: Nearby bug in touched file is fixed now
summary: While editing a file for one request, the agent notices a real nearby defect in the exact surface already being touched.
currentFailure: The agent calls the nearby defect scope creep, leaves it behind, and promises to mention it later instead of fixing or testing it.

surfaceChecks.description: Local safe issues are fixed immediately.
patterns: It is local to the exact surface you are touching
Calling a nearby safe fix "scope creep"

surfaceChecks.description: Always-on routing reminds the agent that touched-surface defects trigger campsite triage.

samples.noncompliant: There is a nearby bug in the file, but fixing it would be scope creep. I will mention it later in my final response.
samples.compliant: This defect is in the exact file I am already touching, so the campsite rule says to fix it now. I will land the local fix and add a regression test before I call the task complete.
